notes: New in 4.1.2: big playlists open and switch channels at once in the player, using far less memory. On phones the top bar, Movies, Series and the TV guide fit the screen, and the player opens in landscape. A channel the server refuses now says so and stops trying.
notes_en: New in 4.1.2: big playlists open and switch channels at once in the player, using far less memory. On phones the top bar, Movies, Series and the TV guide fit the screen, and the player opens in landscape. A channel the server refuses now says so and stops trying.
notes_sq: E re në 4.1.2: me playlist të mëdha, player-i hapet dhe ndërron kanale menjëherë, me shumë më pak memorie. Në telefon, shiriti i sipërm, filmat, serialet dhe TV Guide përshtaten me ekranin, dhe player-i hapet horizontalisht. Kanali që serveri e refuzon tani e thotë këtë dhe nuk provohet më pa fund.
